qualification.details: Special Medical Consultant (SMC) - Pediatrician: MD/DNB or PG Diploma in Pediatrics from a recognized university. Special Medical Consultant (SMC) - Anesthesia: MD/DNB or PG Diploma in Anesthesia from a recognized university. Intensivist: MD/DNB or PG Diploma in General Medicine/Respiratory Medicine/Anesthesia/Critical Care/Emergency Medicine. PG Diploma holders require a minimum of 12 months of experience in Intensive Care. All candidates must possess a valid MMC registration and renewal.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for BMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the BMC Recruitment 2026 is 06 October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the BMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the BMC Recruitment 2026. These positions are for Special Medical Consultant (Pediatrician, Anesthesia) and Intensivist roles.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this BMC recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this BMC recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it via post to the specified address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Intensivist post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Intensivist post varies based on qualification and experience, ranging from Rs. 1,25,000/- to Rs. 2,00,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications for the Special Medical Consultant posts?
faq.answer: For Special Medical Consultant posts, candidates need an MD/DNB or PG Diploma in the respective specialty (Pediatrics or Anesthesia) from a recognized university, along with a valid MMC registration.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for BMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee. General/OBC and SC/ST candidates need to pay Rs. 870 + 18% GST.

faq.question: Q7. What is the contract period for these positions?
faq.answer: The contract period for these positions is until 31 March 2027.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for BMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process involves application screening, followed by an interview. A merit list will be prepared based on qualification and interview marks.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation. The link is provided in the Important Links section.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of BMC?
faq.answer: The official website of Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) is the primary source for all recruitment-related information and form downloads. The link is provided in the Important Links section.
